title: buyNonceLock test: the logger mock gained top-level methods
severity_rationale: Mechanism under test stays real; found because rails make migrateSchema run on a fresh temp DB.

evidence.note: The logger mock gained top-level info, warn, debug, error and fatal vi.fn()s beside the existing child(). No assertion, import, or mocked mechanism changed. withNonceLock stays real. Reason: Found by plan 22-12's run of the 37 reset/doMock files; not caused by the duplicate-load guard (same TypeError with registerSingleton neutralised). The mock exposed only logger.child, and src/utils/dbSchema.ts migrateSchema calls logger.info when it creates a fresh database. Under the rails DB_PATH is an empty per-worker temp file, so the migration now runs; before the rails this test opened the live data/bot.db at schema version 7, so that branch never ran (AUD-TESTU-001).

sibling_sites_checked: Every entry of rails-test-edits.json is registered individually or merged with its discovery. The diff of test/unit/bot/buyNonceLock.test.ts was re-read against audit_base_sha.
